checklist.why: Purpose line names Sheet as the alternative for record forms.
When / when not present; PickerField and ChoiceList exist.
Anatomy named and shown: drawer, scope, Clear, groups, help, Back, counted commit, reason.
One variant (List filters) used by farrowing.room and inspection.filters.
Default, active, empty, disabled, error, loading, long/zh rendered; Disabled now distinct (fieldset and Clear disabled, 'Syncing · filters return when it finishes'); Pressed dropped.
Measured at 390: Clear/Close 48x48, chips 54-72x48 wrapped to two rows, handles 48x48, pickers 348x48, Back 86x48, Show 248x48.
Five parity chips wrap and stay visible; PickerField beyond.
Selected chip has a check; blocked commit and disabled sheet each carry a written reason.
zh cell renders 清除 / 返回 / 显示 12 头母猪 / 7天以上前 – 7天以后; labels come from strings.json (act.clear, act.back, ds.filter.show, fa/in.filter.show.*).
Dialog semantics, visible Back/Close, keyboard on chips and sliders, count in an aria-live button.
New CSS resolves to existing tokens.
Group labels visible; sheet and list summary now agree ('Due: 5 days ago – In 7+ days · Parity 2–5').
Back keeps the draft; list Clear resets applied and draft; reopening after list Clear shows defaults on both screens.
Links Sheet, FilterChips, ChoiceList, PickerField, RangeSlider.
Atlas Overview + List filters: 8 cells, zero 4xx, zero console errors; farrowing.room and inspection.filters console clean; no horizontal overflow at 390.
